title: The candy machine lifecycle
prompt: Implement `CandyMachine`: constructor takes the starting candy count (coins start at 0). `buy()` dispenses one candy and takes one coin — returns false (changing nothing) when out of candy. `restock(n)` adds n candies, allowed at any time. `emptyCoins()` returns the collected coins and **resets the coin count to zero**.

tests.name: machine lifecycle
tests.hint: buy guards on candy count; emptyCoins reads-and-resets; restock has no guard.
